headline: Frontlines Erupt Across Six Sectors as Bases Swap Hands
war_summary: By the evening of day 266 the strategic map shows a dramatic escalation of base turnover. Since the last edition three days ago, the number of regions reporting ownership flips has risen from six to well over a dozen. Weathered Expanse leads with forty‑three flips in the past twenty‑four hours, adding roughly thirteen thousand Colonial and fifteen thousand Warden casualties while enlistments climbed to six hundred. Fishermans Row follows with thirty‑nine flips, centred on Eidolo, Black Well and Arcadia, and a combined loss of more than one thousand men. Stlican Shelf recorded twenty‑five flips across The Old Mourn, The Pale House and Vulpine Watch, with casualties near three thousand each side. Stonecradle, Marban Hollow and Mooring County each saw nine to ten flips, the latter two posting fresh events within the last hour. Callahans Passage, Dead Lands, Farranac Coast, Godcrofts and Linn Mercy also logged multiple captures, though at lower intensity. Most other sectors remain static, showing only incremental losses.
